conclusion: The limited C/TG sizing gain does not establish a design limit. The paper offers switched-buffer timing and parametric T/H mechanisms, whose suitability remains unverified for the current CML topology.

mechanisms.name: Switched sub-channel buffer
mechanisms.finding: Reset output and disable buffer during primary track, enable during hold. Source-follower Cgs tracking-error coupling is analyzed in equations3.7-3.11. Compensation and settling time are required.

mechanisms.name: Parametric T/H gain
mechanisms.finding: Designed change in effective parasitic sampling capacitance100.8fF track to81.4fF hold produces approximately1.24x voltage gain. Does not cancel pre-existing sampled noise.

current_project_difference: Existing selected interstage circuit is continuously biased resistively loaded CML, not the paper source follower; current code does not implement the paper reset/enable sequence or designed parametric topology. No causal diagnosis from paper alone.
NTUST_abstract_only: Confirms input buffer/master sampling and pipelinedSAR ping-pong/passive residue transfer; no circuit or timing detail available, and results are post-simulation in UMC28nm at3.2GS/s.
limits: Complete ADC56GS/s and separate THA64GS/s are distinct prototypes, not112GS/s proof.
Input buffer uses positive and negative supplies; common-mode and available device options need reconciliation.
ADC measurement required output decimation by2 and separate15tap corrections for two frequency bands; nominal8bit is not8ENOB.
Paper explicitly compensates feedthrough/common-mode; this is not proof of random-noise cancellation.
